title: Create src/tui/components/FeatureWizard.tsx — interactive clarification TUI
description: Create an Ink component that shows the feature description and asks clarifying questions one at a time. Shows a progress indicator and a spinner while questions are being generated.
acceptanceCriteria: Feature description is shown in a branded header
Questions are shown one at a time
Pressing Enter advances to the next question
Spinner shown while questions are being generated by AI
onComplete(answers) is called after all questions are answered

steps.details: Create the file. Define props: { featureDescription: string; questions: string[] | null; onComplete: (answers: string[]) => void }. Import useState, TextInput, Box, Text, Spinner.
If questions is null (still loading): render <Box><Spinner /><Text> Generating clarifying questions...</Text></Box>

steps.description: Show questions one at a time
steps.details: const [currentQ, setCurrentQ] = useState(0); const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<string[]>([]); const [input, setInput] = useState(''). Render: <Box flexDirection='column'><Text color='cyan' bold>Feature: {featureDescription}</Text><Text>Question {currentQ+1} of {questions.length}:</Text><Text>{questions[currentQ]}</Text><TextInput value={input} onChange={setInput} onSubmit={handleAnswer} /></Box>

steps.description: Advance through questions and call onComplete
steps.details: function handleAnswer(value: string) { const newAnswers = [...answers, value]; setAnswers(newAnswers); setInput(''); if (currentQ < questions.length - 1) { setCurrentQ(i => i+1) } else { onComplete(newAnswers) } }
